nodes.label: Graph-first codebase navigation
nodes.rationale: Query, path, and explain commands return scoped subgraphs that are usually much smaller than raw searches or the full graph report. Query before searching or reading source, and propagate this rule to subagents exploring code.

nodes.label: Whole-file graph rebuild diff
nodes.rationale: Every build rewrites a committed graph.json in full, so large pull-request diffs are expected and must not be flagged as churn or used to justify skipping graph rebuilds or hooks.

nodes.label: Incremental AST-only graph update
nodes.rationale: Run graphify update after code modifications to keep the graph current without API cost. Dirty graph outputs are expected after hooks and incremental updates.

nodes.label: Flamework template installation
nodes.rationale: Create a project directory, open a terminal there, run npx degit rbxts-flamework/template, and then run npm i.
